name: 62 - API - Process Clinical Intake Case - Corrected V4

nodes.name: Normalize and Validate Clinical Intake Action

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::BIGINT AS case_id,
        $3::TEXT AS action,
        $4::TEXT AS actor_name,
        NULLIF($5::TEXT, '') AS service_name,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS response_to_patient,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS resolution_note
),

case_context AS (
    SELECT
        intake.*,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        request.action,
        request.actor_name,
        request.service_name AS requested_service_name,
        request.response_to_patient AS requested_response_to_patient,
        request.resolution_note AS requested_resolution_note
    FROM clinical_intake_cases intake
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request.case_id = intake.id
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = intake.clinic_id
       AND clinic.name = request.clinic_name
    LIMIT 1
),

service_context AS (
    SELECT
        service.id AS service_id,
        service.name AS service_name
    FROM services service
    INNER JOIN case_context context
        ON service.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND LOWER(service.name) =
           LOWER(context.requested_service_name)
    WHERE context.action = 'route_to_service'
      AND service.is_active = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

ensured_task AS (
    INSERT INTO human_handoff_tasks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,
        task_type,
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        priority,
        status,
        reason,
        due_at,
        assigned_to,
        resolution_code,
        resolution_note,
        resolved_at
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.appointment_id,
        'clinical_triage',
        'clinical_intake',
        context.id,

        CASE context.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN 'urgent'
            WHEN 'high' THEN 'high'
            WHEN 'medium' THEN 'normal'
            ELSE 'low'
        END,

        CASE context.action
            WHEN 'claim' THEN 'in_progress'
            WHEN 'request_more_information' THEN 'open'
            WHEN 'route_to_service' THEN 'resolved'
            WHEN 'escalate_to_doctor' THEN 'in_progress'
            WHEN 'resolve' THEN 'resolved'
            WHEN 'close' THEN 'resolved'
            ELSE 'open'
        END,

        CONCAT(
            'رسیدگی انسانی به پرسش تخصصی اولیه. شرح بیمار: ',
            context.chief_complaint
        ),

        CASE context.risk_level
            WHEN 'urgent' THEN NOW()
            WHEN 'high' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'
            WHEN 'medium' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours'
            ELSE NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day'
        END,

        context.actor_name,

        CASE context.action
            WHEN 'request_more_information'
                THEN 'more_information_requested'
            WHEN 'route_to_service'
                THEN 'routed_to_service'
            WHEN 'escalate_to_doctor'
                THEN 'escalated_to_doctor'
            WHEN 'resolve'
                THEN 'clinical_intake_resolved'
            WHEN 'close'
                THEN 'clinical_intake_closed'
            ELSE NULL
        END,

        COALESCE(
            context.requested_resolution_note,
            context.requested_response_to_patient
        ),

        CASE
            WHEN context.action IN (
                'route_to_service',
                'resolve',
                'close'
            )
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE NULL
        END

    FROM case_context context

    WHERE context.status NOT IN (
            'resolved',
            'closed'
          )
      AND (
            context.action <> 'route_to_service'
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM service_context
            )
          )

    ON CONFLICT (
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        task_type
    )
    WHERE source_record_id IS NOT NULL

    DO UPDATE SET
        priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
        status = EXCLUDED.status,
        reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
        due_at = EXCLUDED.due_at,
        assigned_to = EXCLUDED.assigned_to,
        resolution_code = EXCLUDED.resolution_code,
        resolution_note = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.resolution_note,
            human_handoff_tasks.resolution_note
        ),
        resolved_at = EXCLUDED.resolved_at,
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING *
),

updated_case AS (
    UPDATE clinical_intake_cases intake

    SET
        handoff_task_id = task.id,

        service_id = CASE
            WHEN context.action = 'route_to_service'
                THEN (
                    SELECT service_id
                    FROM service_context
                )
            ELSE intake.service_id
        END,

        assigned_to = CASE
            WHEN context.action IN (
                'claim',
                'escalate_to_doctor',
                'resolve',
                'close'
            )
                THEN context.actor_name
            ELSE intake.assigned_to
        END,

        response_to_patient = COALESCE(
            context.requested_response_to_patient,
            intake.response_to_patient
        ),

        resolution_note = COALESCE(
            context.requested_resolution_note,
            intake.resolution_note
        ),

        status = CASE context.action
            WHEN 'claim'
                THEN 'under_review'
            WHEN 'request_more_information'
                THEN 'awaiting_patient'
            WHEN 'route_to_service'
                THEN 'routed'
            WHEN 'escalate_to_doctor'
                THEN 'escalated'
            WHEN 'resolve'
                THEN 'resolved'
            WHEN 'close'
                THEN 'closed'
            ELSE intake.status
        END,

        resolved_at = CASE
            WHEN context.action IN (
                'resolve',
                'close'
            )
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE intake.resolved_at
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM case_context context
    CROSS JOIN ensured_task task

    WHERE intake.id = context.id

      AND (
            context.action <> 'route_to_service'
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM service_context
            )
          )

      AND intake.status NOT IN (
            'resolved',
            'closed'
          )

    RETURNING intake.*
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
            WHERE status IN ('resolved', 'closed')
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
            WHERE action = 'route_to_service'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM service_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM updated_case
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'clinical_intake_case_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
            WHERE status IN ('resolved', 'closed')
        )
            THEN 'clinical_intake_case_closed'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
            WHERE action = 'route_to_service'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM service_context
        )
            THEN 'service_not_found'

        WHEN request.action = 'claim'
            THEN 'clinical_intake_claimed'

        WHEN request.action = 'request_more_information'
            THEN 'more_information_requested'

        WHEN request.action = 'route_to_service'
            THEN 'clinical_intake_routed_to_service'

        WHEN request.action = 'escalate_to_doctor'
            THEN 'clinical_intake_escalated_to_doctor'

        WHEN request.action = 'resolve'
            THEN 'clinical_intake_resolved'

        WHEN request.action = 'close'
            THEN 'clinical_intake_closed'

        ELSE 'clinical_intake_updated'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
        )
            THEN 'پرونده مطابق کلینیک پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
            WHERE status IN ('resolved', 'closed')
        )
            THEN 'این پرونده قبلاً بسته شده است.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM case_context
            WHERE action = 'route_to_service'
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM service_context
        )
            THEN 'خدمت فعال مطابق نام واردشده پیدا نشد.'

        ELSE 'اقدام انسانی روی پرونده ثبت شد.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS clinical_intake_case_id,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS case_status,

    (
        SELECT risk_level
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS risk_level,

    (
        SELECT recommended_route
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS recommended_route,

    (
        SELECT service_id
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS service_id,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM service_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM ensured_task
    ) AS handoff_task_id,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM ensured_task
    ) AS handoff_status,

    (
        SELECT response_to_patient
        FROM updated_case
    ) AS response_to_patient,

    CASE request.action
        WHEN 'request_more_information'
            THEN 'send_patient_question'
        WHEN 'route_to_service'
            THEN 'continue_appointment_guidance'
        WHEN 'escalate_to_doctor'
            THEN 'doctor_review'
        WHEN 'resolve'
            THEN 'send_resolution_response'
        WHEN 'close'
            THEN 'close_case'
        ELSE 'continue_human_review'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## رسیدگی انسانی به پرونده

اقدام‌های موجود:

- `claim`
- `request_more_information`
- `route_to_service`
- `escalate_to_doctor`
- `resolve`
- `close`

این Workflow پاسخ پزشکی خودکار تولید نمی‌کند. تصمیم و متن نهایی توسط فرد مسئول ثبت می‌شود.

اصلاح V3:
رکورد Human Handoff فقط یک‌بار در هر Statement درج یا به‌روزرسانی می‌شود؛ به‌روزرسانی دوم همان ردیف حذف شده است.

اصلاح V4:
- ویرگول بین CTEهای ensured_task و updated_case اضافه شد.
- ویرگول اضافی بعد از آخرین CTE یعنی updated_case حذف شد.
- خطای Syntax نزدیک updated_case برطرف شد.
